messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT detected — elevated 429 and 503 rates for /v1/generate on prod (us-west-2). Triggered at 2025-08-14T21:03:40Z. Paging oncall. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/alerts/1759004321 :fire:

Jamie (oncall): oncall Jamie — looking now. 429 spike correlates with model-pool ingress. 75% of 429s traced to tenant=acme-42. 503s coming from runtime-proxy clusters (proxy-1 / proxy-2).

Liam (runtime): copy. Do we want a quick soft cap for top noisy tenants? can push transient quota rules to blunt the spike.

Jamie (oncall): yes. soft cap for acme + nimble-saas. reject new requests over cap with 429 (soft mode) so existing sessions keep KV cache. keep bursts small.

Liam (runtime): i'll apply.

Jamie (oncall): also consider toggling the experimental background feature flag 'exp-bench' off (that runs long background jobs). That should drop synthetic load.

runtime-ops: i can flip the flag now.

Liam (runtime): applying quota for acme-42 now:
```
curl -s -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/quotas \\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" \\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\n  -d '{\"tenant\":\"acme-42\",\"qps\":50,\"burst\":100,\"mode\":\"soft\"}'
```

incident-bot: ACTION: quota rule applied to tenant acme-42 at 2025-08-14T21:06:10Z by Liam.

runtime-ops: feature-flag 'exp-bench' toggled off in prod at 21:06:25Z.

Jamie (oncall): metrics check — 429 rate dropped from ~1200 rps to ~320 rps within 90s after quota. 503s are falling slower; looks like runtime proxy queue backlog is draining. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/ingress/429-503-trends

Sara (CS): heading: i'll notify CS/account teams for acme & nimble-saas. drafting response: "We're applying short-term request caps to stabilize service; you may see limited request throughput for a few minutes. We'll follow up with a post-mortem." want to review? :point_left:

Jamie (oncall): message looks good. send.

Liam (runtime): doing a small routing canary to divert 5% of requests to opt-3b (cheaper model) to reduce tokens and tail latency:
```
python ops/route_switch.py --cluster prod --from=opt-8b --to=opt-3b --pct=5 --note \"surge-control 2025-08-14\"
```

Jamie (oncall): noted — keep eval guardrails active so we can detect quality regressions. create a short prompt set for canary.

incident-bot: DEPLOY: routing canary started at 21:07:50Z, pct=5%.

Liam (runtime): routing canary in. watching p50/p95 — early latency down ~10ms.

Jamie (oncall): current plan summary (hand-off-ready):
- Applied soft quota: acme-42 qps=50, burst=100
- Disabled exp-bench feature flag
- Routing canary: 5% traffic -> opt-3b
- CS notified

Jamie (oncall): setting incident state: mitigation in progress. i'll hand primary to Liam for next 30m and will stay available for decisions. handoff at 21:12UTC.

incident-bot: HANDOFF created: from Jamie to Liam at 2025-08-14T21:12:05Z.

Liam (runtime): ack. i'll monitor dashboards and escalate if >10% regression or if 503 > baseline for >5m.

Sara (CS): acme rep updated; they reported some rejected requests but confirmed the app degraded gracefully. CS will ask for a brief summary once stable.

Jamie (oncall): quick telemetry update 21:18UTC — 429s stabilized ~200rps, 503s trending back to baseline. continue to watch KV hit rates and proxy queue length.

runtime-ops: proxy queue length down 80% vs peak. no signs of node oom.

Liam (runtime): rolling back routing canary slowly: restoring 2%->8b now to check latency impact. will pause if p95 spikes.

Jamie (oncall): good. if stable for 30m we'll unwind caps and re-enable exp-bench.

incident-bot: NOTE: events logged to incident-1759004321.runbook.

Sara (CS): CS will follow up with customer note and copy of mitigation timeline.

Jamie (oncall): update 21:28UTC — 429s ~180-220rps, 503s at baseline. beginning controlled unwind: increasing acme cap to qps=150 (soft) and restoring exp-bench in 5m if metrics hold.

Liam (runtime): monitoring. i'll take primary until Jamie resumes at 21:40UTC.

Jamie (oncall): handoff note posted to thread: what changed, why, and how to revert. logs/commands in runbook (link above).

incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigation successful so far. continue monitoring for next 30m. incident status: mitigated->monitoring.

Sara (CS): acme flagged for post-mortem outreach. CS will collect impact metrics.

Liam (runtime): ack. will close once stable for 30m and no regressions.

Jamie (oncall): thanks team — great coordination.
